description: Chaotic voltage source running a simulation of four coupled bodies, with the position and the angle of each of them on its outputs

params.text: Sets how fast the simulated bodies move
Changes properties of the simulation such as gravity and mass, so the bodies move more or less aggressively
Attenuates and inverts the SPEED input before it is added to the SPEED knob
Attenuates and inverts the ENERGY input before it is added to the ENERGY knob
Sets new positions and new velocities for the bodies, and pressed repeatedly can make the pendulum rotate continuously
Reverses the velocities, so every segment moves in the exact opposite direction to the one it was going
Saves the current positions and velocities
Returns the simulation to the saved positions and velocities
Steps through the three simulations: PENDULA is a multi segment pendulum, PLANETS is four bodies pulling on each other by gravity, FISH-TANK is four bodies bouncing inside a container

inputs.text: A control voltage added to the SPEED setting, scaled by the SPEED attenuverter
A control voltage added to the ENERGY setting, scaled by the ENERGY attenuverter
A trigger here sets new positions and velocities for the bodies
A trigger here reverses the velocities of the bodies
A trigger here saves the current positions and velocities
A trigger here returns the simulation to the saved positions and velocities

outputs.text: The horizontal position of that body, -5V to +5V
The vertical position of that body, -5V to +5V
The angle of that body, -5V to +5V

menu: Model — picks the simulation directly: Pendula, Planets or Fish Tank
